Markets.title: Same playbook, different numbers: Why FPI selling may not be the story it looks like
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets fell due to high crude prices, US Treasury yields, geopolitical risks, and foreign portfolio investor (FPI) selling. Despite this trend, foreign investors selectively continued buying Indian IPOs, debt, and mid-cap and small-cap stocks.

Markets.title: J Infratech files IPO papers; eyes Rs 600 cr via fresh issue
Markets.summary: Haryana-based infrastructure firm J Infratech has filed preliminary papers for an initial public offering to raise Rs 600 crore through a fresh issue and promoter offer for sale. The company plans to use the proceeds to support working capital requirements and repay its borrowings.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: 23,270 is a key Nifty hurdle; Sudeep Shah picks 5 stocks, discusses PB Fintech, Turtlemint strategy
Markets.summary: Nifty closed at 23,140.50 following its eighth straight weekly decline amid persistent bearish technical indicators and global market pressures. Analysts note that 23,300 acts as a key resistance level while 23,000 serves as options-based support, with Pharma and Healthcare showing relative strength.

Markets.title: Bitcoin rebounds strongly this week, trades near $84,000 after climbing above $86,000. Here is what experts say
Markets.summary: Bitcoin rebounded this week, trading near $84,000 after briefly climbing above $86,000. The recovery was driven by positive ETF flows and reduced uncertainty following the US Federal Reserve's September policy decision.

Markets.title: Nifty at key 23,000 support: Can bulls trigger a technical rebound?
Markets.summary: The Nifty fell 0.88% to 23,140.50, marking its seventh consecutive week of losses amid bearish technical momentum. The index is currently testing a crucial support zone between 23,000 and 23,200 as market volatility remains high.

Markets.title: FIIs, MFs raise stakes in 10 stocks; shares gain up to 40% in 3 months
Markets.summary: During the June 2026 quarter, foreign institutional investors and mutual funds increased their holdings in 10 Nifty 500 stocks. Following this heightened institutional interest, these shares gained up to 40% over the next three months.

Geo-Political.title: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days. He stated that Tehran made the offer only because they are losing the war.

Geo-Political.title: Pope praises young people's 'energy and commitment' at huge open-air Mass in Paris
Geo-Political.summary: Approximately 700,000 people attended a large open-air Mass in central Paris. During the service, the Pope praised the energy and commitment of young people.

Geo-Political.title: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens
Geo-Political.summary: A suspected gas explosion in a building near the Acropolis in Athens killed six people, including a British national. The remaining victims consisted of four Americans and one Greek national, according to officials.

Geo-Political.title: Security lapses at Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed, review says
Geo-Political.summary: An independent review found security lapses at the Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed. The report also states that Kirk's aides insisted on an outdoor venue despite concerns from campus officials.

Geo-Political.title: German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims
Geo-Political.summary: A town in Germany has banned "stumbling stone" brass memorials dedicated to Nazi victims. The country's education minister strongly criticized this decision, calling it a scandal.

Geo-Political.title: Nor'easter storm brings coastal flooding, as New York and New Jersey declare emergency
Geo-Political.summary: A powerful Nor'easter storm is bringing coastal flooding to tens of millions of people along the East Coast from Maine to Virginia. In response, officials in New York and New Jersey have declared states of emergency.

AI & Tech.summary: An author tested ChatGPT recommendations and found their WordPress SaaS course ranked as the top AI-suggested result without paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is changing organic traffic compared to traditional SEO.

Data & Insights.title: Sitharaman on India’s 10%+ growth potential: Startups and technology can drive next phase
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Sitharaman stated that startups and technology can help India achieve over 10% economic growth. She emphasized that reaching this higher growth level to support Atmanirbhar Bharat and Viksit Bharat will require significant effort from all sectors of society.

Data & Insights.title: India's forex fall by $14.9 billion in a week, says RBI: Where do reserves stand now?
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves dropped by $14.9 billion in a single week, according to the Reserve Bank of India. The decrease was primarily driven by a fall in foreign currency assets, which make up the largest component of the country's reserves.

Data & Insights.title: India's financial, external sectors remain resilient despite global risks: RBI bulletin
Data & Insights.summary: According to the RBI Bulletin, India's financial and external sectors remain resilient despite global risks. This economic strength is supported by strong Q1 growth, a five-year high in net FDI, robust services exports, remittances, and $765.9 billion in forex reserves.

Data & Insights.title: CEA flags US friction, energy shocks, and missing AI play as India’s key near-term risks
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran stated that trade coercion, weaponized supply chains, and rising US bond yields are key near-term risks for India. He warned that these global pressures require India to adopt costlier hedging strategies and a new economic playbook.

Data & Insights.title: India’s growth outlook strengthens as economists see resilient incomes, stable policy: WEF
Data & Insights.summary: According to a WEF survey, 74% of economists expect strong or very strong economic growth in India over the next year. This improved outlook is driven by resilient domestic demand and stable policy expectations.

Data & Insights.title: Centre lowers FY27 borrowing estimate by  ₹1.2 trillion, plans  ₹7.86 trillion bond sales in H2
Data & Insights.summary: The central government has reduced its gross borrowing estimate for the 2027 financial year by ₹1.2 trillion due to stronger-than-expected tax and non-tax revenues. Consequently, the Centre plans to sell ₹7.86 trillion in government bonds during the second half of the fiscal year.

India.title: 'Bigg Boss' Contestant Hits Pune Doctor With Sticks, Utensils To Extort Money
India.summary: Divya Shinde, a reality TV contestant and social media star, was accused of breaking into a Pune doctor's home and brutally attacking him with sticks and utensils. She and her accomplices allegedly assaulted the victim and stole his car after he failed to pay a 5 lakh rupee extortion demand.

India.title: When Two Akali Dals Faced Off At A Fair: Panthic Politics Dominates Chhapar Mela
India.summary: Sukhbir Badal's Shiromani Akali Dal faced Amritpal Singh's Akali Dal at the Chhapar Mela in the absence of other political parties. This direct political clash at the traditional fair occurred just six months before upcoming elections.

India.title: Punjab Sarpanch's Husband Shot, Family Alleges Murder Linked to Drug Tip-Off
India.summary: Navdeep Singh, the husband of a Punjab sarpanch, was shot dead amidst an ongoing personal dispute with a local jeweller named Surinder Singh. His family has alleged that the murder is connected to a drug tip-off.

India.title: Congress, BJP And Allies' Backing: Politics Follows Poll Body's Clarification
India.summary: Following the Election Commission's clarification, BJP ally TDP leader Chandrababu Naidu stated that the issue has been unanimously resolved and misconceptions put to rest. The clarification received backing from both the Congress and the BJP along with its allies.

India.title: 'Your Guidance Gives Me Renewed Energy': Yogi Adityanath Meets PM Modi
India.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Delhi. The meeting followed Amit Shah's praise of Uttar Pradesh for producing BrahMos missiles and AK-203 assault rifles.

India.title: Help Us Get Truth Out: Sahil Wakode Parents' Appeal To IIT Students
India.summary: Sahil Wakode's parents appealed to IIT Bombay students for help in uncovering the truth about their son. His father stated in a video that he had been blocked from entering the campus despite multiple visits.

General.title: Burnham announces scheme to help first-time buyers onto housing ladder
General.summary: Prime Minister Burnham has announced a new housing scheme to assist first-time buyers. The program is specifically designed to help people who cannot rely on financial support from their parents.

General.summary: Heathrow Airport has warned that the construction of its proposed third runway could be delayed by up to four years, potentially missing the government's 2035 completion target. Government ministers responded by stating that the original deadline has always been ambitious.
